note: F-I18N-001 §3.11 locale layout matrix, landing half (landing-locales.spec.ts). Site controls under touchTarget.min (64) at 320, 375 or 768 px today, keyed by what they are and where they go (not their words; a link to the learner app is keyed <app>, whatever origin the export was built with), per English page; /es and /ko pages are held to the English page's list, and shownLocales adds the footer locale switcher, which only a build that shows every locale draws. Never add a line: a new small control fails the matrix until it is at least 64 x 64. When a listed control is fixed, the matrix fails until its line is removed, so this list only shrinks. Making these controls 64 x 64 is an open item (F-I18N-001 §10).
